audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer states twice that Annie has no stun early: whys[0] 'At level 1 Annie has no stun stacked' and whys[1] 'At 2 she still can't threaten a stun'. Riot's Pyromania text says the opposite — 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.'
audit.why: She has a stun at level 1, every game, and again after every death. Telling a Neeko player she is safe to walk up at levels 1-2 is the single most dangerous line on this page, because Neeko has no dash to leave with.
audit.corrected: whys[0] and whys[1] rewritten around the real early advantage, which is range: her Q is 625 against your 800 Q and 1000 E. phases[0].why now states she starts with Pyromania available.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Annie/Annie/Neeko/Neeko. Separately, diff was 'EVEN' at diffRating 5.5/10 on a matchup Neeko wins 43.04% of.
audit.why: The two layers cannot both be right on the same row, and 43.04% is not an even matchup by any reading. The stage shape itself is defensible from the kits — Neeko out-ranges her at every level, Annie takes over when a stocked Pyromania makes a 4s Q into a free stun-burst — but the overall verdict was too kind.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides aligned to the content chart as one atomic group with the whys rewritten; diff moved to TRICKY at 6.5/10 with breakdown.difficulty, report[14].t and tone moved with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 adds the ambush; Luden's makes the package lethal' — level 6 is Annie's stage on this chart, not Neeko's.
audit.why: Level 6 is a stocked stun into Tibbers at 600 range against an immobile champion; that is her spike, not yours. Your stage is the first item, when Tibbers is on 130s at rank 1 and she is a 625-range caster with nothing banked.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is the kill pattern; her stacked stun owns 4-6; first items hand it back to you.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (defect 3), and the field named Summon: Tibbers as the thing to track when the actual gate is Pyromania — which is a cast counter, not a cooldown.
audit.why: Pyromania stuns on her next offensive spell after four casts. You cannot count it on a timer; you count her spells. Nothing on the page told the reader that, and no real number — Q at 4s, W at 7s, E at 10s, R at 130/115/100 — appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now carry the four-cast rule, the fact that she starts every life with it stocked, and the Q/W/R numbers against Neeko's 800 Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: enemyWin claimed Annie beats you by 'out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time'. Her longest offensive range is 625; Neeko's Q is 800 and E is 1000.
audit.why: Annie does not out-range Neeko in any slot. She wins by making you come to her, or by stunning you from inside her range — the opposite of the stated mechanism.
audit.corrected: Annie wins by stocking Pyromania, opening with a point-and-click stun at 625, and dropping Tibbers on top of you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Annie was addressed as he/his/him across the full layer — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t, report[11].t, report[13].t — while the content layer had her correctly as she/her.

Copy-paste bleed on four bullets: dosFull[0].d (title 'Walk the clone at trade range as a decoy') carried the Tibbers line; dontsFull[1].d (title 'Spend the root on chip') carried the clone paragraph, which also warned about 'assassin timers' against a champion with no dash; dontsFull[2].d (title 'Disguise-engage without R ready') carried tradeBad verbatim; dontsFull[0].d was a name-swap template.
audit.why: Defect 2, plus a template phrase that is factually wrong about this enemy.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to answer their own titles from Annie's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d and report[5].t both centred on 'Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun'. Flash-buffering is not in Riot's text and the kit file cannot confirm it.
audit.why: The brief is explicit that Flash-buffering is not in the data and must not be asserted from it. The claim may well be true, but it is not sourced here.
audit.corrected: Both fields rewritten around what the kit does state — the four-cast Pyromania rule and Tibbers' 600 range on a 130s rank-1 cooldown. The Flash interaction is left out rather than repeated.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood claimed 'the full package is half a bar at level 3' — magnitude with no source (defect 6) — and gave no exit cue.
audit.why: Disintegrate is a flat 4s. That is the number that decides how long you can stand in your own trade.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the sequence plus 'walk before her 4s Q returns'.

notes: The most important fix here is not the chart — it is that the content layer told the reader Annie has no stun at levels 1 and 2. Riot's Pyromania text says she begins the game and respawns with it available. Two whys corrected. packet.defects flagged the chart against the win rate: Neeko is at 43.04% over 79 games but the chart gives her 5 of 7 stages. I could not resolve that from the kits, so I did NOT invent stage flips — I aligned the full layer to the content chart (which matches packet.levelChart exactly) and instead moved the overall verdict, which was 'EVEN 5.5/10' on a 43% matchup, to TRICKY 6.5/10. See questionsForUser: the late rows may well belong to Annie and that is a data call, not a kit call. 'Flash-Tibbers' appeared in two fields; Flash-buffering is not in the kit data so I rewrote both around the four-cast Pyromania rule rather than repeat an unsourced claim. Fields left templated and ungrounded: breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, loading, tradeBad, report[12].t. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
